note: Every id must be on at least one slide (slide.sections) or listed in meta.coverage_skipped with a reason. Core ids cannot be skipped. One slide may cover several ids.

sections.title: Executive summary
covers: Verdict in words, the one sentence that justifies it

sections.title: Business model and revenue generation
covers: How does the company generate revenue?
What is its business model, and how does it create value?
What are its primary revenue streams and sources of profitability?
suggested_visuals: text with columns (what it sells, who pays, how it earns)

sections.title: Business segments and revenue breakdown
covers: Segments by product, service, customer type and geography
Revenue and profitability contribution of each segment
Core growth drivers and the most important segments
suggested_visuals: stacked-bar or stacked-100 of segment revenue
segmented-bar for geography or end market

sections.title: Competitive advantage and economic moat
covers: Barriers to entry, switching costs, network effects, IP, scale, brand (where they apply)
suggested_visuals: cards (one per moat source, each with evidence and a durability tag)

sections.title: Industry and sector analysis
covers: Growth prospects, maturity, cyclicality, long-term trends
Demand drivers, technology shifts, structural changes
Competitive landscape, concentration, the company's relative position
suggested_visuals: bar of TAM by year (sourced, vendor flag if the source sells research)

sections.title: Pricing power and customer retention
covers: Ability to raise prices without hurting demand
Customer price sensitivity and demand elasticity
Retention, contract structure, recurring revenue, customer concentration
suggested_visuals: matrix (differentiation vs switching cost, one point per product line)

sections.title: Products and services, lifecycle and development
covers: Main products and their lifecycle stage
Effect of new products on revenue, margins and position
suggested_visuals: table of products with lifecycle stage

sections.title: Key dependencies and operational risks
covers: Dependence on major customers, suppliers, channels, technologies, partners
Exposure to key components, IP or third-party platforms
Impact if a critical dependency breaks

sections.title: Management, board and governance
covers: Background and track record of the CEO, CFO and key executives
suggested_visuals: table of pay mix from the DEF 14A
KPIs for insider ownership and board independence

sections.title: Strategic threats and competitive risks
suggested_visuals: cards or a risk table with likelihood and impact (own view, marked basis view)

sections.title: Mergers, acquisitions and strategic investments
covers: Did they strengthen the position or add risk
suggested_visuals: cards (one per deal with price, year, rationale, verdict)

sections.title: Growth strategy and geographic expansion
covers: Where and why the company will expand
Required investment, execution risk, expected benefit

sections.title: Overall business quality assessment
covers: Business model, advantages and long-term sustainability
Strongest attributes and biggest structural weaknesses
Durability of position and of profits and cash flows
Quality judged apart from the share price
suggested_visuals: scorecard (8 to 10 criteria, 1 to 5, each with a one-line reason)

sections.title: Revenue performance and growth
suggested_visuals: bar of revenue with annotations at inflection points
sections.data: series revenue, revenue_growth; values revenue_cagr; quarterly revenue

sections.title: Revenue mix and growth quality
covers: Revenue by segment, product, geography, end market

sections.title: Profitability and margins
suggested_visuals: line of gross, operating, net margin

sections.title: Earnings quality and normalized profitability
sections.data: normalized_operating_income, gain_on_divestiture, amort_intangibles, restructuring, sbc_pct_revenue, share_count_change

sections.title: Cash flow generation and conversion
covers: Operating cash flow and free cash flow
Cash conversion, earnings to cash reconciliation
suggested_visuals: bar with two series (net income vs free cash flow)
line of FCF margin and FCF less SBC margin
sections.data: cfo, fcf, fcf_margin, fcf_less_sbc, cfo_to_net_income, fcf_conversion

sections.title: Working capital efficiency
covers: Cash conversion cycle, operating working capital
Working capital needs relative to revenue
suggested_visuals: line of DSO, DIO, DPO and CCC

sections.title: Debt, liquidity and financial risk
covers: Net debt and net debt to EBITDA
Debt to equity and interest coverage
sections.data: total_debt, net_debt, net_debt_to_ebitda, interest_coverage, debt_to_equity, debt maturities

sections.title: Capital expenditure and capital intensity
covers: Maintenance versus growth capex where estimable
suggested_visuals: line of capex % revenue and capex to depreciation

sections.title: Capital allocation
suggested_visuals: stacked-bar of uses of cash (acquisitions, buybacks, dividends, debt repaid)
sections.data: cum_* values, buybacks, dividends_paid, acquisitions, debt_repaid, shares_diluted

sections.title: Returns on capital and shareholder performance
covers: Returns against the cost of capital
suggested_visuals: line of ROIC and ROIC normalized against WACC as a reference line
sections.data: roic, roic_normalized, roe, roa, eps_diluted, shares_diluted, wacc

sections.title: Financial outlook and key takeaways
covers: Sustainability of growth, margins, cash flow
What it means for forecasting and valuation
suggested_visuals: cards or text with two columns

sections.title: Competitor analysis (playbook 1.13)
covers: Competitive positioning: product quality, features, pricing, value versus main competitors
Pricing power: which competitors can raise prices without losing customers
Competitive exposure by product, customer segment and geography
Competitive threats to share, profitability and growth

sections.title: Ownership and insider activity (playbook 1.14)
covers: Institutional ownership: major holders and changes
Insider ownership and significant purchases or sales
Buybacks: size, rationale, effect on value
suggested_visuals: table of top holders (sourced, with date)
sections.data: insiders.json, DEF 14A beneficial ownership table, buybacks series

sections.title: Competitive pressures and brand strength (playbook 1.15)
covers: Credible customer surveys and independent studies against competitors

sections.title: Multiples versus peers and own history
covers: P/E, EV/EBITDA, EV/sales, P/FCF, FCF yield against peer medians
Same multiples against the company's own 5-year range
suggested_visuals: hbar of one multiple across peers
sections.data: values pe_ttm, ev_ebitda_ttm, ev_sales_ttm, p_fcf_ttm, *_hist_avg, peer_median.*

sections.title: DCF scenarios and sensitivity
covers: Bear, base, bull assumptions with reasons
Value per share in each case and the probability-weighted value

sections.title: Reverse DCF: what the price assumes
covers: Owner FCF growth and revenue growth the current price implies
Whether that is plausible against history, guidance and the industry

sections.title: Valuation summary (football field)
covers: All methods on one chart against the price
Where the price sits and what has to go right

sections.title: Thesis and what would change my mind
covers: The investment case in three short paragraphs
Four to six measurable signposts that would change the view
